entry.title: Music and Thought
entry.summary: During the intermission of a concert, someone once asked me, “What do you think about when you listen to music?” Now that’s a really interesting question. Most of the time, we don’t think about what we listen to. It’s entertainment; a pleasant noise in the background to keep our minds from wandering, not to help it wander.
